title: Namelist Extension
description: STAC Namelist Extension for STAC Items and Collections, exposing Fortran namelist parameters as CQL2 queryables.

nml:parameters.title: Flattened namelist parameters
nml:parameters.description: Maps 'component__file__group__key' to the parameter's value (a repeated group is indexed as 'group_N'), for CQL2 filtering. Component-qualified so two components sharing a filename cannot collide. Keys are JSON-path-safe (only [A-Za-z0-9_]) so pgstac can filter them without queryables registration.

propertyNames.$comment: A flattened key: word characters and the '__' segment separator only; every other character in a segment is sanitised to '_'.

scalar.title: Scalar
scalar.description: A single namelist value: string, number, boolean, or null.

queryable_value.title: Queryable value
queryable_value.description: A namelist parameter exposed for CQL2 filtering: a scalar, or a list of scalars (possibly empty, heterogeneous, or containing nulls). Nested groups are dropped before emission.

item_fields.title: Namelist item fields
item_fields.description: STAC Item properties: every 'nml__{component}__{file}__{group}__{key}' key maps to a queryable value; foreign (non-nml__) core properties are unconstrained.

propertyNames.$comment: Foreign props pass; nml__ keys are JSON-path-safe (word characters and the '__' separator only).
